conclusion: The default Windows CMake install prefix is build/InlongSlicer. The install_only_inlong target writes build/InlongSlicer_InlongOnly, rejects other output paths, removes the previous filtered output, and copies Release EXE/DLL files, bundled Python, runtime libraries and non-profile resources. Its nine allowed profile roots are InlongFilamentLibrary, INLONG, _Infinity3DP, user, their three vendor manifest JSON files, blacklist.json and hotend.stl. Pages 21 and 24 load the shared guide/21/common.js printer selector; patch that shared implementation in the filtered output, rather than page-specific initialization stubs. The full guide resources and source JS remain unchanged. prepare_empty_data_dirs and direct install hooks reset data_dir in the configured Release binary folder and both local package folders, including incremental no-op builds. Preserve needed portable user settings before invoking these native targets. Local package generation does not itself publish a release or prove committed-source release readiness.
